title: Is there any method or plugin that would let one character have multiple turns in a row?

posts.author: MrPotatoHead232
posts.body:
Hello, I want to make a game in RPG Maker MZ with a battle system I created. Basically, the player will have 3 Turn Points. Certain attacks take certain amounts of Turn Points (TP). For example, the basic attack command will take 1 TP. Your turn remains until you run out of TP. When you use a move that will deplete your TP, it is considered a finisher, and has different traits. If you have 1 TP left and use the basic attack command, it would turn into a finisher, since the attack command costs 1 TP and you have 1 left. When attack is used as a finisher, it deals 20% more damage. That's the most basic implementation.
Would this be possible, or is it too complex for RPG Maker MZ?

posts.author: Solar_Flare
posts.body:
The simple feat of having multiple turns in a row is trivially done in MZ - you just add a trait for "Attack Times: 100%" and they gain an extra turn.
I'm not sure how much work the rest of your idea would take. I think it sounds possible, but likely requires a plugin.

posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
For multiple actions per turn, the
Action Times+
trait works on everyone. I don't think it would suffice here, though, because it just extends the input phase: skill costs, like TP, are only paid during the action phase. I believe you'd want a plugin that lets you define "instant" skills or something similar.
Answers may depend on the battle system you're using. Which one are you using: Turn-based, Time Progress, or something from a plugin (if so, what system from which plugin)?

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: Hmmm just fill your project with VisuStella plugins, set the battle system as STB (that's kind of like default battle system but actions happen immediately after selection) and at the end of all action sequences make a conditional that checks your battler's turn points and if they're above 0, use MECH: STB Extra Action (make action sequences for items too). You can also add the finishers to the action sequences by checking the turn points and modifying the damage multipliers or adding whatever effects you want.

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
MrPotatoHead232 said:
Would this be possible, or is it too complex for RPG Maker MZ?
Click to expand...
Just to answer this part directly. Yes, you could make something like this by creating your own battle system using Events. It is entirely possible. Whether or not it is too complex is determined by each user based on their knowledge, experience, skill, and willingness to learn. The engine can handle it, it just depends on if the user can create it.
I can just say that I am working on 100% Eventing my own interactive systems for my game because I want to make them do exactly what I want without having to try to cobble together a bunch of plugins that don't necessarily play well together and still don't give me what I want.
In that journey, I may even learn enough to make my own plugins that do exactly what I want my Events to do so it ends up being more efficient.
I have also seen people post about making their own battle systems so it can be done within the engine.
There may be plugins that can be used to get exactly what you want already, but just know that your concept isn't too complex for the engine itself.

posts.author: Ludovinsky
posts.body: MZ already has a built-in TP system, but it functions differently from your concept. You could repurpose the MP (Magic Points) system to act as your Turn Points, as it allows for specific costs for each action.
